messages:
alex: Heads up: planning blue->green swap for api-router-eu tonight at 02:30 UTC. Target deploy is runtime:v3-canary -> runtime:v3. Change window 02:30-03:30. Canary ran for ~8h across 8 hosts.

alex: Proposed progression: 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%. Hold times: 4m, 4m, 6m, 6m. Session affinity cookie stays on, TTL 90m. Pinning behavior enabled for 10m after full cutover.

marie: ACK. I'll watch SLO dashboards and traces. I'll also keep top endpoints list open.

diego: ACK. Request: make the first hold 4m (ok) but reduce the 10% hold to 3m if all green — saw stable behavior in staging.

alex: okay: 2% 4m, 10% 3m, 30% 6m, 60% 6m.

deploy-bot: Action -> preparing router config for `api-router-eu`. Will publish weights at 02:30:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: STEP 1 -> blue weight=2% at 02:30:32 UTC.

marie: traffic flowing to v3, 200s. p95 baseline 95ms, current p95 110ms. error rate 0.01%.

deploy-bot: STEP 2 -> blue weight=10% at 02:34:45 UTC.

sam: seeing increased 502s on /v1/stream around 02:36. Small spike to 0.25%.

alex: logs show a handful of v3 workers returning 502 with message `worker-exec OOM`. Diego, can you check memory guard?

diego: looking. Canary instances show memory pressure on requests >1500 tokens. We didn't enable the memory cap for v3 in this rollout.

alex: that's over our tolerance. Rollback rule: any sustained 5xx >0.2% for 3m triggers rollback. We're at 0.25% sustained 2m and rising.

sam: recommend rollback now. Marie, confirm metrics.

marie: confirmed 5xx at 0.28% for 2m and trending. p95 also up +180ms vs baseline.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK -> setting blue weight=0% and green weight=100% at 02:38:20 UTC.

deploy-bot: Router weights restored to green 100% at 02:38:40 UTC.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-311 created, owners: diego, marie. Pager + oncall notified.

alex: pinned `api-router-eu` to runtime:v2-stable in config and disabled progressive rollout for this model tag.

diego: capturing heap dumps and request traces from canary hosts. I see a correlation with long sequence requests and a GC stall leading to OOM.

marie: I'll draft a short incident note and attach dashboard snapshots. Action items: (1) enable worker memory guard for v3, (2) add synthetic long-seq warmup to canary pipeline, (3) re-run canary with new guard.

alex: set follow-up: canary retry scheduled tomorrow 01:00 UTC. Add a gating rule to require zero upstream OOMs for 30m before 30% traffic.

oncall-pager: Follow-up task created: RFC-4767 for memory guard and canary warmup.

sam: thanks everyone. We'll keep the v3 canaries around for debugging but no traffic until fixed.

deploy-bot: Note: rollout aborted and restored at 02:38:40 UTC. All auto rollouts disabled for tag `runtime:v3`.

alex: closing thread — will update when RCA draft is ready. Good catch and fast rollback :thumbsup!
